Check whether an action can be executed.

A cluster with no remaining children cannot be split. The interface can remove that choice and preserve the case for further review.

CURRENT BEHAVIOR

Offer KEEP, SPLIT, and DISCARD for every cluster.

− An impossible SPLIT can interrupt the review.

PROPOSED BEHAVIOR

Read the current tree state before presenting actions.

+ If the node is a leaf, offer KEEP, DISCARD, or DEFER.

Data & inputs

Import a dataset

Choose the matching full dataset ID. Uploaded MAT size and SHA256 must match that approved input. No model is started.

Available datasets

Import jobs

Reason library

CSV needs a text or reason column. One reason per line in text files. Existing reasons are retained; duplicates are skipped.

Restore feedback

Check a v3 export, then restore missing reviews to the current reviewer. Existing reviews and their history are preserved. Import the referenced dataset views first.

Reviewer identity

The name in the page header is saved on the server. To continue your review history on another computer, copy this reviewer key and use it there. This local SSH workspace has no account login.
